summary: Frontend-only verification of the Nifty 50 Value 20 (v20) addition + null-fill engine changes in /simulator.html. All 8 scenarios pass; no JS console/page errors; no NaN or '—' where data exists; long 2005/2006 history preserved for the 7 long indices while v20 is safely null-filled pre-2009-01-01. Distribution chart uses the correct 6 fixed bands. Blend, equity rebase, jump-to-date (including pre-2009 region), and SIP/Lumpsum modes all render correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: Chart.js instance is not exposed on window/canvas which makes deep dataset introspection from external tests harder; consider assigning charts to window.__charts for testability (non-blocking).
Bands constant is inlined inside run() rather than a top-level named constant — refactor for readability (non-blocking).
